description: A keys member that is a string, with an unregistered alg foo, fails with InvalidKey: the set import comes first; decided by ADR 0054 §4 precedence: JWK Set import errors (1) come before selector validation (2), so InvalidKey and not the UnsupportedAlgorithm of alg foo; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
